description_en: Queries the status of an asynchronous task
description_zh: 调用GetTaskStatus查询异步任务的状态
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso get-task-status --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --task-id t-shfqw1u1edszvxw50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTaskStatus

TaskStatus.description_en: The status information about the task

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

FailureReason.description_en:
The cause of the task failure.

This parameter is returned only when the value of `Status` is `Failed`
FailureReason.description_zh:
任务失败原因。

只有`Status`为`Failed`，才会显示该参数

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

InProgress: The task is running.
Success: The task is successful.
Failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

InProgress：任务执行中。
Success：任务执行成功。
Failed：任务执行失败

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:

ProvisionAccessConfiguration: An access configuration is provisioned.
DeprovisionAccessConfiguration: An access configuration is de-provisioned.
CreateAccessAssignment: Access permissions on an account in the resource directory are assigned.
DeleteAccessAssignment: Access permissions on an account in the resource directory are removed
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：

ProvisionAccessConfiguration：部署访问配置。
DeprovisionAccessConfiguration：解除访问配置部署。
CreateAccessAssignment：在RD账号上授权。
DeleteAccessAssignment：移除RD账号上的授权
